- [$bindable](svelte/02-runes/06-$bindable.md): Ordinarily, props go one way, from parent to child. This makes it easy to understand how data flows around your app.
- [$inspect](svelte/02-runes/07-$inspect.md): > [!NOTE] $inspect only works during development. In a production build it becomes a noop.

## 99-legacy

- [Overview](svelte/99-legacy/00-legacy-overview.md): Svelte 5 introduced some significant changes to Svelte's API, including [runes](what-are-runes), [snippets](snippet) and
- [Reactive let/var declarations](svelte/99-legacy/01-legacy-let.md): In runes mode, reactive state is explicitly declared with the [$state rune]($state).
- [Reactive $: statements](svelte/99-legacy/02-legacy-reactive-assignments.md): In runes mode, reactions to state updates are handled with the [$derived]($derived) and [$effect]($effect) runes.
- [export let](svelte/99-legacy/03-legacy-export-let.md): In runes mode, [component props](basic-markup#Component-props) are declared with the [$props]($props) rune, allowing par
- [$$props and $$restProps](svelte/99-legacy/04-legacy-$$props-and-$$restProps.md): In runes mode, getting an object containing all the props that were passed in is easy, using the [$props]($props) rune.
- [on:](svelte/99-legacy/10-legacy-on.md): In runes mode, event handlers are just like any other attribute or prop.
- [<slot>](svelte/99-legacy/20-legacy-slots.md): In Svelte 5, content can be passed to components in the form of [snippets](snippet) and rendered using [render tags](@re
- [$$slots](svelte/99-legacy/21-legacy-$$slots.md): In runes mode, we know which [snippets](snippet) were provided to a component, as they're just normal props.
- [<svelte:fragment>](svelte/99-legacy/22-legacy-svelte-fragment.md): The <svelte:fragment> element allows you to place content in a [named slot](legacy-slots) without wrapping it in a conta
- [<svelte:component>](svelte/99-legacy/30-legacy-svelte-component.md): In runes mode, <MyComponent> will re-render if the value of MyComponent changes. See the [Svelte 5 migration guide](/doc
- [<svelte:self>](svelte/99-legacy/31-legacy-svelte-self.md): The <svelte:self> element allows a component to include itself, recursively.
- [Imperative component API](svelte/99-legacy/40-legacy-component-api.md): In Svelte 3 and 4, the API for interacting with a component is different than in Svelte 5. Note that this page does not 
- [Legacy APIs](svelte/99-legacy/index.md)
